balanced.message: Page 9: Rabbit is asked to show where Amber landed, but points to the creek post where he moved it. The prior pages establish that Amber landed in the fern hollow. The unacknowledged mismatch makes the clue exchange confusing, especially because Rabbit points to the hollow on the next page. Evidence on page 9: “Rabbit pointed toward Amber’s new post, then toward Blue’s hiding place.” Related page 6: “East of the gate post, Rabbit spotted a warm glimmer in a fern hollow.
